description: Inference stream transcripts and the typed outcome each client must map them to. Streamed content is never retained server-side, so none of these outcomes may trigger an automatic retry.

cases.name: completed-two-deltas
cases.description: Normal completion: created, two text deltas, completed terminal.

cases.name: completed-with-comment-lines
cases.description: SSE comment lines inside an event block and multibyte output must be tolerated.

cases.name: incomplete-capped-partial-output
cases.description: Budget-capped response: partial output, incomplete terminal, capped charge.

cases.name: incomplete-empty-output-uncharged
cases.description: Uncharged no-output case: the provider completed upstream but delivered no output text, so the reservation is released and credits.charged is 0. Clients must surface this as a distinct, branchable incomplete outcome, not an error.

cases.name: error-event-after-output
cases.description: A typed error event after deltas: surface code, operation id, and partial output; never auto-retry.

expect.partial_output: The first half of an ans

cases.name: error-event-before-created
cases.description: A typed error event before response.created carries no operation id.
cases.sse:
event: error
data: {"type":"error","error":{"code":"accounting_failed","message":"The response could not be settled."}}

expect.error_message: The response could not be settled.

cases.name: interrupted-after-deltas
cases.description: Stream ended without a terminal event: typed interruption with the operation id and partial output.

cases.name: interrupted-before-created
cases.description: Stream ended before response.created: typed interruption with no operation id.

cases.name: invalid-comment-only-block
cases.description: A blank line terminating a block with no event or data is a protocol violation in the strict v0.1 profile.

cases.name: invalid-duplicate-created
cases.description: A second response.created event is a protocol violation.

cases.name: invalid-delta-before-created
cases.description: A delta before response.created is a protocol violation.

cases.name: invalid-delta-operation-mismatch
cases.description: A delta whose response_id does not match response.created is a protocol violation.

cases.name: invalid-terminal-status-mismatch
cases.description: A response.completed event whose status field says incomplete is a protocol violation.

cases.name: invalid-unknown-event-name
cases.description: An unknown event name is a protocol violation.

cases.name: invalid-non-json-data
cases.description: A data field that is not strict JSON for the named event is a protocol violation.
